cover_headline: Ayodhya's 10th Deepotsav Lights Over 30 Lakh Diyas Across 56 Saryu Ghats
facts: More than 30 lakh earthen lamps were lit across 56 ghats along the Saryu in Ayodhya on Saturday, November 7, for the 10th Deepotsav
More than 35,000 volunteers lit the lamps, and a 2,100-drone show recreated scenes from the Ramayana over the riverfront
No Guinness World Records adjudicator's count appeared in the reports read on the night, so the official total is not yet certified; the 2025 record stood at 26.17 lakh lamps

end.headline: Ayodhya's 10th Deepotsav Lights Over 30 Lakh Diyas Across 56 Saryu Ghats
end.line: Reports from the night put the count above 30 lakh lamps — with the official Guinness tally still awaited against 2025's 26.17 lakh record.
